body:
## Context

Add a simple local-only dashboard control that updates this app to the latest implementation from git.

## UX

- Add a small `Update App` control in the footer or Settings page, not as a primary dashboard CTA.
- Show app version details near the control:
  - current branch
  - short commit SHA
  - dirty/clean state
- Button states:
  - idle: `Update App`
  - running: disabled, `Updating...`
  - success: `Updated to <sha>. Restart the dashboard to use the latest version.`
  - already current: `Already up to date.`
  - local changes: `Local changes detected. Update manually to avoid overwriting work.`
  - failure: short error plus copyable fallback command: `git pull --ff-only && uv sync`

## Mechanic

Keep the first implementation conservative and server-side.

Add endpoints:

- `GET /api/app-version`
  - returns branch, current short SHA, upstream status if available, and dirty state
- `POST /api/update`
  - refuses when the worktree is dirty
  - refuses when no upstream branch exists
  - runs `git pull --ff-only`
  - runs `uv sync` after a successful pull
  - returns old SHA, new SHA, status, and short command output/error text

Implementation notes:

- Use `subprocess.run([...], cwd=repo_root, timeout=...)` with argument arrays, not shell strings.
- Do not run arbitrary browser-provided commands.
- Do not support branch switching from the UI.
- Do not auto-stash or overwrite local changes.
- Do not auto-restart in the first version.
- Use `POST`, not `GET`, for the update action.
- Because the app currently binds to `0.0.0.0`, restrict the update endpoint to localhost requests or clearly gate/document it as local/private only.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The update control is keyboard accessible.
- The button shows progress and final state.
- Dirty worktree blocks update.
- Fast-forward-only pull is used.
- `uv sync` runs after a successful pull.
- The app reports restart-required after a successful update.
- Existing dashboard data refresh behavior is unchanged.
- Tests cover success, dirty-worktree block, no-upstream block, and git/uv failure cases.
title: Add simple local update button for dashboard app
